text:
How can #AI support NCD prevention in countries with limited resources?
 
This demo from International Telecommunication Union shows https://t.co/aF2LgM67Lv, an open-source framework that lets governments build their own AI services. Each service answers only from a knowledge base the national institution curates itself, and every answer cites its sources.
 
In The Gambia, “AI twins” give people guidance on #hypertension and quitting #tobacco. They work in local languages, by chat, voice or WhatsApp, and remind users to check with a health professional. The answers draw on trusted guidance, including the @WHO  – @ITU  Be He@lthy, Be Mobile handbook on mHypertension. The same core runs an agricultural advisory service in El Salvador.
 
Grounded, transparent and locally owned AI is how digital tools can strengthen #NCDs prevention and primary care, without replacing them.
